references.text: Moses exhorts Israel to keep the commandments and statutes that the Lord has given them
Moses calls Israel together to hear the laws and statutes of the Lord which they are to learn and keep
The commandments, statutes, and laws that the Lord commanded Moses to teach Israel, so that they would fear the Lord and keep them
Exhortation to keep all the commandments that the Lord commands today
Israel is to love the Lord and always keep his statutes, laws, commandments, and decrees
Today the Lord commands you to keep these statutes and laws with all your heart and all your soul
Promise of blessing if Israel listens to the voice of the Lord and keeps his commandments and statutes
Command to keep all the Lord's statutes and laws and do according to them
Jesus says that those who love him will keep his commandments
Jesus says that those who keep his commandments remain in his love, just as he has kept his Father's commandments
Love for God is that we keep his commandments, and his commandments are not burdensome
